description: When is the next PCE inflation report? Returns the next scheduled Personal Income and Outlays release from the US Bureau of Economic Analysis, which carries the PCE and core PCE price indexes the Federal Reserve targets, with the month it covers and the time in Eastern, UTC and your time zone (London by default). For traders, economists and Fed watchers. It gives the schedule only, not the inflation figures. (cost: 1 credit)

timezone.description: string, optional, IANA time zone for the local time fields (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Tokyo), default Europe/London

name: next_pce_inflation_release
